statement: In the setup above, either in relative rational Chow or in the indicated quotient by base support, there is a supercommutative rational algebra B with the following properties. (i) The curve correspondence algebra has a faithful tensor model on B ⊗ Q1 ⊕ Wb ⊕ Qe  , where 1, e are even and Wb is an odd symplectic space of dimension 2b. The classes 1C, e′ C correspond to 1, e, and η projects onto Wb. Integration gives the hyperbolic pairing ⟨1, e⟩ = 1, ⟨1, 1⟩ = ⟨e, e⟩ = 0 on the two even summands and the symplectic pairing on Wb. All actual Chow correspondences between curve powers, not only pairing diagrams, are included faithfully in this model. (ii) The projected small diagonal is an alternating three-form φ: W3 b −→ Bodd. Cup product, integration, tensor products, permutations, and contractions are computed in the model with the Koszul signs. 19 (iii) Let U be a finite-dimensional ordinary rational color space. A pure colored tensor in  η⊗k A∗ (Ck ) ⊗ U⊗k ⊗ sgnk  Sk (4.2) is zero if and only if all its evaluations using the same ordinary linear map z : U → Wb in every slot are zero in B. Finitely many rational maps z suffice for each fixed U, k. The assertion holds in the base-support quotient as well. In particular, a product of projected cubic entries is tested by products of φ(z(i), z(j), z(k)), with the fixed Koszul sign coming from the ordering of the factors. A vanishing established by these tests is a vanishing in Chow, with the stated base-support bound.
